What happens next

A local pool company that is independent of this line will look at your request and call the number you gave. Keep your phone close, since the call back may come from a number you do not recognize. Anything about the visit, the price and the work is between you and that company.

If the pool needs help right away, do not wait for the call back. Phone the free line at (520) 372-1083 any hour and the automated assistant can put you through. For a gas smell, sparks or anyone hurt, call 911 first.

Call (520) 372-1083

While you wait, the how it works page explains the handoff, and the services page covers what a local company can help with.

Tucson Pool Cleaning Pro is a free phone line, not a pool company. It answers your call and connects you with an independent local pool service company, which inspects, quotes and does the work, and which you pay directly. Companies may pay a referral fee. The line never charges you.
